# An ambiguous fragment

A passing thought, no clear topic, no clear lane, possibly relevant to
several articles, possibly not relevant at all. Could be about
deployment, could be about onboarding, could be a stray observation
that doesn't compress well. Low classifier confidence → route to
`_drafts/` with `confidence: low` and `reason: <classifier-output>`.
Never archive without a wiki target.
